passages.text: Now the Spirit of God came upon Azariah son of Oded.
passages.sermon: Azariah was the son of Oded.\r\nThe Spirit of God came upon Azariah.
passages.original: וַעֲזַרְיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ עוֹדֵ֔ד הָיְתָ֥ה עָלָ֖יו ר֥וּחַ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: So he went out to meet Asa and said to him, “Listen to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin. The LORD is with you when you are with Him. If you seek Him, He will be found by you, but if you forsake Him, He will forsake you.
passages.sermon:
Azariah was a prophet.
The Spirit of God came upon Azariah.
Azariah went out to meet Asa.
Azariah spoke to Asa.
Azariah said, "Listen to me, Asa."
Azariah also spoke to all Judah and Benjamin.
Azariah said, "The LORD is with you when you are with Him."
Azariah said, "If you seek the LORD, you will find Him."
Azariah said, "If you forsake the LORD, He will forsake you."
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵא֮ לִפְנֵ֣י אָסָא֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ שְׁמָע֕וּנִי אָסָ֖א וְכָל־ יְהוּדָ֣ה וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן יְהוָ֤ה עִמָּכֶם֙ בִּֽהְיֽוֹתְכֶ֣ם עִמּ֔וֹ וְאִֽם־ תִּדְרְשֻׁ֙הוּ֙ יִמָּצֵ֣א לָכֶ֔ם וְאִם־ תַּעַזְבֻ֖הוּ יַעֲזֹ֥ב אֶתְכֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: For many years Israel has been without the true God, without a priest to instruct them, and without the law.
passages.sermon:
Israel is the subject.
Israel lived for many years.
During these years, Israel did not have the true God.
Israel did not have a priest to teach them.
Israel did not have the law.
passages.original: וְיָמִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְלֹ֣א׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֱמֶ֗ת וּלְלֹ֛א כֹּהֵ֥ן מוֹרֶ֖ה וּלְלֹ֥א תוֹרָֽה׃

passages.text: But in their distress they turned to the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought Him, and He was found by them.
passages.sermon:
Israel suffered distress.
Israel turned to the LORD.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
Israel sought the LORD.
The LORD let Israel find Him.
passages.original: וַיָּ֙שָׁב֙ בַּצַּר־ ל֔וֹ עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְבַקְשֻׁ֖הוּ וַיִּמָּצֵ֥א לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: In those days there was no safety for travelers, because the residents of the lands had many conflicts.
passages.sermon:
In those days, people could not travel safely.
Travelers faced danger.
People who left their homes were not safe.
People who entered towns were not safe.
The people who lived in the lands had many conflicts.
There was much trouble among all the residents.
passages.original: וּבָעִתִּ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין שָׁל֖וֹם לַיּוֹצֵ֣א וְלַבָּ֑א כִּ֚י מְהוּמֹ֣ת רַבּ֔וֹת עַ֥ל כָּל־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Nation was crushed by nation, and city by city, for God afflicted them with all kinds of adversity.
passages.sermon:
God afflicted the people with many troubles.
Nations attacked other nations.
Cities fought against other cities.
God caused these hardships for everyone.
passages.original: וְכֻתְּת֥וּ גוֹי־ בְּג֖וֹי וְעִ֣יר בְּעִ֑יר כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֥ים הֲמָמָ֖ם בְּכָל־ צָרָֽה׃

passages.text: But as for you, be strong; do not be discouraged, for your work will be rewarded.”
passages.sermon: You must be strong.\r\nDo not let your hands grow weak.\r\nGod will reward your work.
passages.original: וְאַתֶּ֣ם חִזְק֔וּ וְאַל־ יִרְפּ֖וּ יְדֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֛י יֵ֥שׁ שָׂכָ֖ר לִפְעֻלַּתְכֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Azariah son of Oded the prophet, he took courage and removed the detestable idols from the whole land of Judah and Benjamin and from the cities he had captured in the hill country of Ephraim. He then restored the altar of the LORD that was in front of the portico of the LORD’s temple.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
Azariah was a prophet and the son of Oded.
Azariah spoke words and a prophecy from God.
Asa heard these words and the prophecy.
Asa became courageous.
Asa removed the detestable idols from the whole land of Judah.
He also removed the idols from the land of Benjamin.
He removed the idols from the cities he had captured in the hill country of Ephraim.
Asa restored the altar of the LORD.
This altar stood in front of the portico of the LORD’s temple.
passages.original: וְכִשְׁמֹ֨עַ אָסָ֜א הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה וְהַנְּבוּאָה֮ עֹדֵ֣ד הַנָּבִיא֒ הִתְחַזַּ֗ק וַיַּעֲבֵ֤ר הַשִּׁקּוּצִים֙ מִכָּל־ אֶ֤רֶץ יְהוּדָה֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן וּמִן־ הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכַ֖ד מֵהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיְחַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֕ר לִפְנֵ֖י אוּלָ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And he assembled all Judah and Benjamin, along with those from the tribes of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon who had settled among them, for great numbers had come over to him from Israel when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.
passages.sermon:
King Asa was the ruler of Judah.
He gathered all the people of Judah and Benjamin.
He also gathered people living among them from the tribes of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon.
Many people from Israel joined Asa.
They saw that the LORD, Asa’s God, was with him.
So, large numbers came over to him.
passages.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֗ץ אֶת־ כָּל־ יְהוּדָה֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן וְהַגָּרִים֙ עִמָּהֶ֔ם מֵאֶפְרַ֥יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וּמִשִּׁמְע֑וֹן כִּֽי־ נָפְל֨וּ עָלָ֤יו מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל֙ לָרֹ֔ב בִּרְאֹתָ֕ם כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֖יו עִמּֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: So they gathered together in Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
In the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign, the people gathered.
They assembled in Jerusalem.
They came together in the third month of that year.
passages.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֥וּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לִשְׁנַ֥ת חֲמֵשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה לְמַלְכ֥וּת אָסָֽא׃

passages.text: At that time they sacrificed to the LORD seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep from all the plunder they had brought back.
passages.sermon:
The people of Judah and Benjamin gathered in Jerusalem.
Many people from Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon joined them.
They came because they saw that the LORD was with King Asa.
They brought back much plunder from their battles.
On that day, they sacrificed animals to the LORD.
They gave seven hundred oxen to the LORD.
They gave seven thousand sheep to the LORD.
They offered these animals from the plunder they had brought.
passages.original: וַיִּזְבְּח֤וּ לַיהוָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא מִן־ הַשָּׁלָ֖ל הֵבִ֑יאוּ בָּקָר֙ שְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֔וֹת וְצֹ֖אן שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִֽים׃

passages.text: Then they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and soul.
passages.sermon:
The people of Judah gathered in Jerusalem.
They made a covenant together.
They promised to seek the LORD.
The LORD is the God of their fathers.
They promised to seek Him with all their heart.
They promised to seek Him with all their soul.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ בַבְּרִ֔ית לִדְר֕וֹשׁ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם בְּכָל־ לְבָבָ֖ם וּבְכָל־ נַפְשָֽׁם׃

passages.text: And whoever would not seek the LORD, the God of Israel, would be put to death, whether young or old, man or woman.
passages.sermon:
The people of Judah made a covenant with the LORD, the God of Israel.
They agreed to seek Him with all their heart and soul.
They set a rule for everyone in Judah.
Anyone who did not seek the LORD, the God of Israel, would be put to death.
This rule applied to every person.
It included both young and old.
It included both men and women.
passages.original: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ יִדְרֹ֛שׁ לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יוּמָ֑ת לְמִן־ קָטֹן֙ וְעַד־ גָּד֔וֹל לְמֵאִ֖ישׁ וְעַד־ אִשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: They took an oath to the LORD with a loud voice, with shouting, trumpets, and rams’ horns.
passages.sermon:
The people of Judah made a promise to the LORD.
They spoke with a loud voice.
They shouted.
They blew trumpets.
They blew rams’ horns.
passages.original: וַיִּשָּֽׁבְעוּ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה בְּק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל וּבִתְרוּעָ֑ה וּבַחֲצֹצְר֖וֹת וּבְשׁוֹפָרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And all Judah rejoiced over the oath, for they had sworn it with all their heart. They had sought Him earnestly, and He was found by them. So the LORD gave them rest on every side.
passages.sermon:
All the people of Judah rejoiced because of the oath.
They had sworn the oath with all their heart.
They had sought the LORD, the God of Israel, with all their desire.
They found the LORD because they sought Him earnestly.
The LORD gave them rest on every side.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׂמְח֨וּ כָל־ יְהוּדָ֜ה עַל־ הַשְּׁבוּעָ֗ה כִּ֤י בְכָל־ לְבָבָם֙ נִשְׁבָּ֔עוּ וּבְכָל־ רְצוֹנָ֣ם בִּקְשֻׁ֔הוּ וַיִּמָּצֵ֖א לָהֶ֑ם וַיָּ֧נַח יְהוָ֛ה לָהֶ֖ם מִסָּבִֽיב׃

passages.text: King Asa also removed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother because she had made a detestable Asherah pole. Asa chopped down the pole, crushed it, and burned it in the Kidron Valley.
passages.sermon:
King Asa ruled over Judah.
Maacah was King Asa’s grandmother.
Maacah served as queen mother.
Maacah made a detestable Asherah pole.
King Asa removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
Asa cut down the Asherah pole.
Asa crushed the pole.
Asa burned the pole in the Kidron Valley.
passages.original: וְגַֽם־ מַעֲכָ֞ה אֵ֣ם׀ אָסָ֣א הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ הֱסִירָהּ֙ מִגְּבִירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ עָשְׂתָ֥ה לַאֲשֵׁרָ֖ה מִפְלָ֑צֶת וַיִּכְרֹ֤ת אָסָא֙ אֶת־ מִפְלַצְתָּ֔הּ וַיָּ֕דֶק וַיִּשְׂרֹ֖ף בְּנַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: The high places were not removed from Israel, but Asa’s heart was fully devoted all his days.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
He served God with a loyal heart all his life.
The high places remained in Israel.
No one removed the high places from Israel.
passages.original: וְהַ֨בָּמ֔וֹת לֹא־ סָ֖רוּ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֧ק לְבַב־ אָסָ֛א הָיָ֥ה שָׁלֵ֖ם כָּל־ יָמָֽיו׃

passages.text: And he brought into the house of God the silver and gold articles that he and his father had dedicated.
passages.sermon:
King Asa was the king of Judah.
King Asa took silver and gold articles.
King Asa and his father had dedicated these articles.
King Asa brought these articles into the house of God.
passages.original: וַיָּבֵ֞א אֶת־ קָדְשֵׁ֥י אָבִ֛יו וְקָֽדָשָׁ֖יו בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כֶּ֥סֶף וְזָהָ֖ב וְכֵלִֽים׃

passages.text: And there was no war until the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.
passages.sermon: Asa was king of Judah.\r\nNo one fought against Judah during Asa’s reign for thirty-five years.\r\nThere was peace in the land during this time.
passages.original: וּמִלְחָמָ֖ה לֹ֣א הָיָ֑תָה עַ֛ד שְׁנַת־ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְחָמֵ֖שׁ לְמַלְכ֥וּת אָסָֽא׃ס
